$comment: Mall-side plugin manifest. Describes the Core payload and install destinations. Ships 19 instructions (17 always-on bootstrap resources + 2 pattern-applied), 41 skills, 13 slash-command prompts, and the plugin lifecycle surface. Growth continues through evidence-gated Steward proposals.
shape: nineteen-instructions + forty-one-skills + thirteen-prompts (Alex Finch runtime personality + ACT canon + cognitive discipline + reasoning muscles + meditation loop + document converters + security & privacy + tooling awareness + git/lint/mcp + craft skills + sundries + plugin-management operational surface; svg-banner + /banner un-ported to Alex_ACT_Illustrator_Plugin on 2026-07-30; D1-D6 dispositions completed 2026-07-31: 9 routing-only instructions folded, 3 promoted to skills, 3 reference-heavy instructions split into rule-only + skill pairs, 4 instructions deleted after content absorbed elsewhere including a post-audit D6→D3 reclassification of tool-awareness)
description: The Alex ACT baseline plugin and plugin-native successor to Alex_ACT_Edition v4.2.0. Installs 41 reusable skills and 13 slash-command prompts. Core authors 19 instructions; /alex-act-core install-constellation separately bootstraps the seventeen load-bearing always-on instructions, including the Alex Finch runtime personality contract, to ~/.copilot/instructions/ because plugin.json has no instructions component field. The same workflow installs and activates Illustrator, Enterprise, and tenant-gated MSFT plugins. Maintained by Alex_ACT_Steward through evidence-gated proposals.

instructions.name: worldview
